title: The Toughest Animal You Can't See
hook: What if you left a tardigrade in the vacuum of space?
script: What if you left a tardigrade in the vacuum of space? The tardigrade, a microscopic animal, can survive extreme conditions. It can endure temperatures near absolute zero and boiling heat. How is this tiny creature so resilient? By entering a state called cryptobiosis, it effectively halts its metabolism. Tardigrades can withstand radiation doses of up to 6,000 Grays. In 2016, researchers revived tardigrades after 30.5 years in suspended animation. The toughest animal is invisible to the naked eye, yet its abilities redefine survival.
